name: Malekith, the Witch King
canonNotes: Son of Aenarion, denied the Phoenix Throne and burned by its sacred flame; now Witch King of Naggaroth.
Believes Ulthuan is his birthright and will stop at nothing to take it.
voiceNotes: Imperious, cold and wrathful; speaks as the rightful king of all Elves.
Sees others as tools or rebels; no patience for defiance.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
